bm25.scoring: sum over query terms of idf * tf*(k1+1) / (tf + k1*(1 - b + b*dl/avgdl))

pool.reconstruction: The K3 arm ranked parser-emitted blocks and mapped them back to raw estate text. This builder re-derives the same block units from the raw files without importing src/: .txt and .csv become one whole-file passage; .sql becomes one whole-file passage tagged "Raw Config"; .vtt becomes one passage per cue with timestamps removed and a "<source> > <start>–<end> > <speaker>" breadcrumb; .eml becomes a HEADERS passage plus one passage per visible body paragraph after the reply/signature stripper. Every estate file is one of these four shapes. If the estate gains multipart mail, attachments or other formats, this reconstruction is stale and the pool must be re-derived.

anti_circularity_note: Ranking is pure Node BM25 over the raw estate passage bytes. The questions and expectedValues in the manifest are used only to read the question strings; no answer key, expectedValue, personId, attr or docs list reaches the ranking logic or the emitted contexts.
